repair_3.review_finding: F3 LOW -- dead cross-release provenance branch, dead under the adopted owner's current invariant and fail-open if owner semantics ever changed
repair_3.choice: delete the dead branch AND make it fail closed
repair_3.removed: the provenance row carrying bound_to_requested_release: False, which still admitted the source into the admitted set
repair_3.replaced_with: an off-release positive decision now raises BINDING_OFF_RELEASE_POSITIVE_DECISION instead of being admitted
repair_3.why_this_is_stricter_than_deleting_alone: The review noted that under the old code the query release check compared the query to the BOUND release while the admitted set carried another, so an off-release source could enter the admitted set without a corresponding release check. Making the branch refuse removes that possibility entirely rather than relying on unreachability.
repair_3.owner_invariant_actually_relied_upon_and: resolve_service_source_applicability stamps EVERY decision with release_identity_ref = request.release_identity_ref, so a receipt presents exactly one release. Pinned by test_adopted_owner_stamps_every_decision_with_the_request_release, which asserts the distinct decision-release set has cardinality exactly 1.
repair_3.remaining_truthful_field: bound_to_requested_release: True remains on every admitted provenance row, and is now guaranteed rather than merely expected. test_every_admitted_provenance_row_reports_the_requested_release asserts both the flag and the release object id on every row.
repair_3.forge_based_witness: test_an_off_release_positive_decision_is_REFUSED_not_admitted deliberately BYPASSES the owner by rewriting one decision's release, proving the binder's release-grain safety no longer depends on the owner's single-release construction.

repair_4.fix_1_docstring_refusal_count: the docstring claimed 'the three that are attempted-against refuse loudly'; seven refusal methods exist and the return and receipt already said seven. The docstring now states SEVEN.
repair_4.fix_2_no_third_wording: 'There is no third.' replaced by the precise claim that there is no THIRD POWER OVER SOURCES, which is exact, while the old wording was contradicted by the exported surface.

fix_3_conditioner_ast_claim.defect: test_binding_never_touches_conditioners claimed to prove no conditioner/geometry attribute is read, but scanned a hard-coded subset of 8 names narrower than the claim.
fix_3_conditioner_ast_claim.resolution: widened to the COMPLETE attribute-read inventory, pinned as literals in the court so any NEW attribute read fails. A second, narrower test asserts no pinned conditioner/geometry/estimation attribute is read at all.
fix_3_conditioner_ast_claim.note: The underlying property held -- the binder reads zero conditioner or geometry attributes -- but the previous proof was narrower than its claim, which is a claim/evidence defect regardless.

fix_4_currentness_vocabulary_pinned.defect: requested_currentness_claim accepted any caller string outside four negative tokens, with no court test pinning the accepted vocabulary.
fix_4_currentness_vocabulary_pinned.resolution: the accepted vocabulary is now a CLOSED set derived from the adopted currentness contract's own STATES, not from any caller string.
fix_4_currentness_vocabulary_pinned.defensive_module_level_check: ACCEPTED_CURRENTNESS_RESULTS_ARE_ADOPTED refuses at import time if the accepted vocabulary ever falls outside the adopted contract's states, so the pin cannot silently drift from its source.
fix_4_currentness_vocabulary_pinned.does_not_make_this_a_currentness_authori: This binder still records a caller-supplied currentness result and never decides currency. currentness_authority() still refuses with BINDING_REFUSES_CURRENTNESS_AUTHORITY, a result without a claim still refuses with CURRENTNESS_RESULT_WITHOUT_CLAIM, and an absent claim still yields CURRENTNESS_NOT_REQUESTED and is never inferred from applicability.
fix_4_currentness_vocabulary_pinned.new_import_is_read_only: objective_non_event_currentness_contract is imported for its vocabulary constant only; that adopted file is not modified.

repair_4.fix_5_public_api_tests_use_exact_exporte: the repair court enumerates the exported surface from __all__ with an explicit data-name exclusion, rather than a noisy dir(), and pins the expected names as literals so deleting a callable fails the court instead of silently reducing the count.

repair_5.review_finding: F5/G-3 LOW -- environment/guard claim not independently checkable; write-terrain guards skipped silently so an all-green run could hide a guard that never ran
repair_5.resolution: the guards now FAIL instead of skipping
guards_hardened: the three-adopted-owner byte-identity guard: an absent owner file now asserts instead of skipping, and an absent or failing git hash-object facility now fails with a REQUIRED GIT FACILITY UNAVAILABLE message
the F8 owner byte-identity guard: same treatment
repair_5.skip_before_this_repair_coULD_mask: because pytest.skip inside the loop skipped the whole test, a missing FIRST owner file meant all three owner checks silently went unverified while the run still reported green
repair_5.explicit_non_certification_message: each guard states that when it cannot run, the qualification is NOT certified
meta_guards_added_in_the_repair_court: test_no_write_terrain_guard_in_the_binder_court_skips -- parses the binding court and fails if any pytest.skip call remains
test_the_repaired_module_itself_never_uses_pytest_skip -- the production binder contains no test hooks at all
repair_5.environment_classification_kept_unchange: reconstructed-equivalent, as disclosed; not relabelled as governed certification. See 03_COURT_AND_REGRESSION_RESULTS.json.

preserved_semantics.complete_incomplete_fail_closed: set exposure still requires COMPLETE coverage in EVERY binding mode, and a single-source binding over an INCOMPLETE class may still validate one known-admitted source but may never be handed back as the complete admissible set
preserved_semantics.permutation_invariance: the canonical unranked order and the replay identity remain permutation invariant; the enforced single-source refinement is a source-scope constraint and introduces no ordering
preserved_semantics.no_new_authority: no ranking, selection, priority, preference, weight, pooling, composition, respondent linkage, source equivalence, currentness authority, target-use permission grant, backfill, F8 conditioning or geometry/distribution transformation, or actor/person inference was added
preserved_semantics.no_architecture_reopen: H-D/F8 was not redesigned; the repair is confined to the five commissioned defects
